### ✨ Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature you would like to see in AnimaFind.

### 🎮 Problem or Gameplay Opportunity
Is your feature request related to a problem or an opportunity? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...", "It would be great to have new card abilities for...")

### 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or visual concept you'd like to see implemented.

### 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
How should this look in the Field Journal aesthetic? (e.g. tape accents, holographic card effects, scanner HUD improvements).

### 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, sketches, mockups, or biodiversity ideas here.
